sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: The file aims to relax certain tx errors related to loading tx accts, from protocol violations to runtime errors. Per the file, specifically, if a tx fails to load a valid program acct or exceeds the requested maximum loaded acct data size, the tx may be included in (per the file) a block, and the tx fee is to be charged. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.

Per the file, relax additional constraints: SIMD-0082 (per the file) sought to relax additional constraints, (per the file) but has not been accepted. The file is a subset of (per the file) SIMD-0082, intended to make (per the file) the review process simpler and faster. Per the file, therefore, we have decided (per the file) to keep this proposal (per the file) focused specifically on certain loading failures.

paragraphs: Per the file, transactions that would previously (per the file) have been dropped with (per the file) a protocol violation error (per the file) can now be included and is to be charged fees. Per the file, users has to be more careful when constructing txs to ensure they are executable if they fail to want to waste fees. Per the file, block-production is simplified as it may be done without needing to (per the file) load large program accts for the initial decision to include a tx.
